services.description: Records a beat every few seconds.

removals.reason: Reference System.Configuration.Install: the worker uses Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting
Reference System.ServiceProcess: the worker uses Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting
service installer: sc.exe (install.ps1) or the container platform installs the worker

nextSteps: dotnet publish src/Heartbeat.Worker/Heartbeat.Worker.csproj -c Release -r win-x64, then run install.ps1 from the output as an administrator
On Linux: install heartbeat-worker.service with systemd (see the comment at its top)
offramp config convert, to move app.config settings to appsettings.json
Review the regions marked OFR4102 in the workers; then remove what the removals list names from the service project

diagnostics.message: Heartbeat.HeartbeatService handles OnPause, OnContinue; the host has no pause, continue, or custom commands, so HeartbeatWorker keeps them as methods the application can call (Pause and Continue set Paused, which the timer loop honors).
Heartbeat.HeartbeatService uses ServiceBase.RequestAdditionalTime, which the host does not have; HeartbeatWorker keeps the statement in an excluded region (OFFRAMP_SERVICEBASE) to review.
src/Heartbeat/Heartbeat.csproj runs 2 services (Heartbeat, Janitor); the worker project hosts one worker for each in one process.
Heartbeat depends on EventLog; a container or systemd unit does not start those first, so the worker must wait for or retry them.
Heartbeat.JanitorService.OnSessionChange handles session changes, which the host does not deliver; it is kept in an excluded region of JanitorWorker.
